current_phase: Phase 1 - Foundation (verified) -- next phase pending owner sequencing decision

repository_state.notes: Phase 1 Foundation complete and verified: jarvis_core/ (config, observability, permissions, plugin loader, storage, core service), 26 automated tests passing, CI wired up (.github/workflows/tests.yml), security review performed (found and fixed unenforced loopback binding, D-0013). No first-party plugins ship yet; no AI/voice/automation exists (later phases).

implemented_features: Layered config system (defaults -> YAML file -> env overrides), validated via Pydantic (jarvis_core/config)
Structured logging to console + rotating file (jarvis_core/observability)
SQLite storage layer with permission_grants and audit_log tables (jarvis_core/storage)
Capability-based permission system: deny-by-default store, tier classification, require() enforcement gate with audit logging (jarvis_core/permissions)
Plugin manifest schema + directory-based discovery with per-plugin failure isolation (jarvis_core/plugins)
Core HTTP service (FastAPI/Uvicorn, loopback-only) with /health and /status endpoints (jarvis_core/service)
verified_features: Config system: 4 automated tests passing (defaults, file override, env override, path resolution)
Permission system: 8 automated tests passing (deny-by-default, grant/revoke, full-catalog seeding, tier mapping, require() allow/deny paths, audit-log write)
Plugin discovery/registry: 6 automated tests passing (empty dir, missing dir, valid manifest, invalid manifest isolation, no-manifest dir skipped, registry register/get/list)

Core service: 8 automated tests passing (in-process /health and /status, loopback-enforcement allow/reject cases), plus one manual real-socket smoke test confirming the service boots, serves real HTTP, and persists a real SQLite file
Phase 1 -- Foundation: verified complete per roadmap.md's bar (implementation + 26 tests + integration + documentation + security review + CI). See phase_completion_records/P001-completion.md.
known_risks: Primary device (HP EliteBook 645 G9) has no dedicated GPU, so the local-tier/cloud-tier split (D-0006) is a hard constraint on later phases, not a preference.
No first-party plugins exist yet, so plugin isolation has only been tested against synthetic fixtures, not a real plugin -- plugin *execution* (vs. manifest loading) is unbuilt and unreviewed.
The core service has no authentication yet; it is only safe because of the loopback-only enforcement (D-0013) -- must be revisited before any phase exposes it beyond localhost.
roadmap.md's Phase 2 (Voice) before Phase 3 (Brain) ordering may not make practical sense -- voice has nothing to talk to without a brain. Flagged to owner, not yet resolved (see current_phase.md).
Android integration approach and specific cloud AI provider(s)/cost ceiling remain open, deferred to Phase 7 and Phase 3 respectively.
next_actions: Owner decides next-phase sequencing: follow documented order (Phase 2 Voice next) or reorder to Phase 3 (Brain) first -- see current_phase.md.
Once decided, record it in decisions.md and begin that phase's implementation using the same process Phase 1 used.
